failure_summary.description: Agent repeatedly picks up, cools, and places the same object due to over-verification and uncertainty about state completion.
Agent fails to terminate correctly, calling done() prematurely or ignoring successful placement, leading to step exhaustion.

patch.reasoning: The trajectory shows a systematic loop where the agent doubts whether the cooling transformation succeeded, causing it to re-pickup, re-cool, and re-place the object. It also struggles with the `done()` command. These edits simplify the cooling workflow, enforce decisive termination upon placement, warn against over-verification loops, and clarify `done()` fallback behavior to prevent step exhaustion.

edits.target: | Cool & Place | Cool object X and put in/on Y | Find X -> take X -> go to fridge -> open -> move X in -> close -> cool X -> open -> take X -> go to Y -> put X |
edits.content: | Cool & Place | Cool object X and put in/on Y | Find X -> take X -> go to fridge -> cool X with fridge -> go to Y -> put X in/on Y |

**Decisive Termination**: Upon successfully placing the transformed object at the destination, call `done()` immediately. Do not re-pickup, inspect, or re-process the object to "verify" state changes. Internal transformations (cooling/heating/cleaning) are confirmed by the action success message.

edits.target: - **Premature termination**: Do not stop the episode until all goal conditions are verified as met.
edits.content: - **Over-verification loops**: Do not pick up a placed object to "check" if it was cooled/heated/cleaned. Trust the action feedback. Re-handling the object wastes steps and often leads to infinite loops.

edits.target: **Only choose admissible actions**: Always pick an action from the admissible action list. Do not invent actions.
edits.content: **Only choose admissible actions**: Always pick an action from the admissible action list. Do not invent actions. If `done()` is not listed or returns "Nothing happens," consider the task complete once the final placement action succeeds.
